_comment: Connector recipes for REST ingestion. A preset only fills the options form — it is data, not code, and it is validated by tests.test_api_presets against the real option schema.

presets.name: GitHub REST
presets.description: Repositories, issues and events. GitHub paginates with a Link header and caps pages at 100 rows.

presets.name: Shopify Admin
presets.description: Orders, products and customers from the Admin REST API, via its Link-header paging.

presets.name: HubSpot CRM
presets.description: Contacts, companies and deals. HubSpot returns rows under results and pages with an after cursor.

presets.name: Notion database query
presets.description: Rows of one Notion database, read with its start_cursor paging.

presets.name: Linear (GraphQL)
presets.description: GraphQL resources with pageInfo cursors, sent as a POST body template.

body.query: query($cursor: String) { issues(first: 100, after: $cursor) { nodes { id title createdAt } pageInfo { endCursor } } }

presets.name: Generic offset pagination
presets.description: Endpoints that take ?offset=&limit= and answer a JSON array.

presets.name: Generic page-number pagination
presets.description: Endpoints that take ?page=&per_page= starting at page 1.

presets.name: Generic cursor pagination
presets.description: Endpoints whose response carries a next_cursor, with rows under items.
